notes.title: Echo Tokyo: Reaper
notes.content:
The newest game by developer Dharker Studios will be coming out February 2024 and will be the newest addition to the Dharker Studios Bundle.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33021098/4a78b423b830ea10cb894224119fb2a29a5da524.png[/img]

Echo Tokyo: Reaper will continue within the cyber punk world with a new multi-route adult adventure for you to determine the fate of not just the protagonist but the people he meets along the way.

Wishlist the game now to be ready for release:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/762010/Echo_Tokyo_Reaper/

notes.title: Yuuki's Party Night Releasing
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the next game in our Paradise series is releasing on February 21st. 

The game follows Yuuki as she goes out for a party. A costume party no less where she gets to enjoy wearing some of her cosplay outfits out and about and maybe finds romance or just has some fun.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/973550/Yuukis_Party_Night/

The game was funded via [url=https://www.patreon.com/DharkerStudio]Patreon[/url], thank you to all of our supporters and testers for making this visual novel game release possible.
